chapter: Taped excerpts: friends, family and facts
title: The Three Arts Club and managing the Ink Spots
summary: He does not recall the Three Arts Club; he became road manager for Bill Kenny's Ink Spots after the group's manager fell out with them.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Okay. What was the Three Arts Club?
You sound good today. Yeah, how did you happen to manage the Inkspots? How did that come about?
Well, I was doing some -- something in the art package for Bill Jenny.
Bill Jenny. He was a tall boy with the high voice.
And really three quarters of his quartet and one quarter was Charlie Sinkwet (PHONETIC). So (inaudible) just took, his manager and he fell out, his road
manager. So he didn't know what to do as far as his rights. (Inaudible) why don't you let J. C. try it? And (inaudible) some advice and guidance and all the rest. That was all it was.
How long were you road manager for them?
Oh, I can't tell you right this minute.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Did you enjoy it?
